QuestInfo.name: The Corn Dog Boondoggle
QuestInfo.0: You decide to stop by the #m402000200# and pick up a Corn Dog to sate your hunger. Find #bGusto#k in the #m402000200#.
QuestInfo.1: As you supped on the tasty corn dog, a chill runs down your spine.
QuestInfo.2: It appears the ingredients you've gathered have vanished.

0.0: Well hey there, sugar! Here to get your hands on one of Gusto's famed corn dogs? All aboard the Flavorzone Express!\r\n
0.1: Normally, I charge 1,000 mesos a dog. But for you, sweetie, it's only #b900#k. Can't have my best customer going hungry!\r\n

0.msg: #b(Your stomach whines eagerly. Well, perhaps one corn dog would be all right...)#k\r\n
#b(Is now really the time for this? The clock is running out on your assigned mission.)#k\r\n
Hey Gusto. One more corn dog, this time with the works.

1.msg: #b(Something's not right. A chill runs down your spine.)#k

0.msg: Hey sugar, thanks for the spending money!

1.msg: Ugh, that dastardly delinquent is scaring away all my business!

2.msg: #b(That petty thief ran off with the ingredients for your dinner! Maybe Gusto knows where he went.)#k

0.msg: #b(Hmm, it looks like you don't have enough money for any more corn dogs.)#k\r\n
